units.source_text: 源氏公子召右卫门佐前来，叫他送信与空蝉。

en.t: Prince Genji summoned Uemon no Suke and told him to deliver a letter to Utsusemi.

units.source_text: 右卫门佐想道：“事隔多年，我以为他早已忘记了。

en.t: Uemon no Suke thought, "After so many years, I had assumed he had long since forgotten her.
How remarkably constant his feelings are!"

units.source_text: 公子寄空蝉的信上写道：“前日关口相逢，足证宿缘非浅。

en.t: In the letter the prince sent to Utsusemi, he wrote, "Our meeting the other day at the barrier is proof enough that our bond from former lives is not shallow.
I wonder whether you feel the same.
